title: History and notification fixes
summary: This update fixes several History and notification problems and adds an Unraid Community Apps installation option.
highlights: History imports now keep rollback intact on MariaDB. Search treats % and _ as literal text, and episode links open the exact History result.
Web Push can re-enroll after a signing-key change, tracks delivery failures per device, and leaves unrelated open tabs alone when you click an alert.
Old Jellyseerr requests no longer send delayed alerts when notifications are re-enabled. Background worker settings and status now agree.
You can install Jellydash from Unraid Community Apps using the SQLite template. Existing Compose installations are not moved automatically.
